info.title: POH patient mobile API
info.description: Mobile team contract: OTP sign-in, direct OTP-proven registration, self-profile read/update with a profile photo (presigned upload to the private patient bucket), refreshing patient sessions and self-only in-person appointments with hospital approval. Passwords collected at registration are hashed for future use; password sign-in is not exposed. Use patient access tokens, never staff credentials or service-account API keys. See docs/mobile-app-login.md and docs/mobile-appointments.md.

post.summary: Submit own in-person appointment for staff approval
post.description: Only request_id, slot_id and optional patient_notes are accepted. Patient is determined by access token. New submission holds one seat and returns 201 pending. An identical request_id+normalized payload replay returns 200 with the same booking’s latest status; changed payload returns 409. The receipt and booking commit atomically. No family, cancellation/reschedule request or online payment is provided.

post.summary: Verify OTP and select a patient account
post.description: Verify OTP. Existing numbers receive one patient token pair/user per live patient. New numbers receive is_new_user:true, empty accounts, a registration_token and expires_in:600; no patient is created yet. Failed OTP attempts remain counted.

post.description: No bearer auth required. Save both new tokens. Previous refresh token has a 2-minute retry grace; reuse after grace revokes the session. Default refresh lifetime is 60 days.

401.description: Expired, revoked or wrong token type; sign in again.

post.description: Uses refresh token even when access expired. Always returns 200, including invalid tokens. Other profile sessions remain signed in.

get.description: Self only. Deleted/merged patient, revoked session or changed phone invalidates access. Patient tokens are refused by staff APIs.

patch.description: Patient comes exclusively from the access token. Changes shared Care patient data, including staff views. Rechecks the live session and phone. Set or remove the profile photo with profile_photo_id (see POST /users/me/profile-photo); text fields and the photo can be saved together. No family IDs, mobile/password changes or account deletion. Returns the updated user, with a fresh presigned profile_photo URL, in the common envelope.

withPhoto.summary: Text fields and a new photo

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked patient session.

422.description: Invalid, unsupported or inconsistent profile fields, or a profile_photo_id that is unknown, not uploaded yet, empty, over 5 MB or of a different type than requested.

post.description: Stores token on current patient session only; does not send push notifications.

post.summary: Complete an OTP-verified new patient registration
post.description: Creates patient, PRE identifier for selected facility, account with hashed password and patient session atomically. No staff author, payment, arrival or appointment. Returns 201. Consumed proof or number now registered: 409; repeat OTP sign-in to recover after a lost success response. Invalid/expired/phone-mismatched proof: 422. Creation lock busy: 423, retry shortly. Existing accounts cannot use this endpoint to change details.

409.description: Already registered or proof consumed. Sign in using OTP.

423.description: Patient creation is busy; retry shortly.

post.description: Step 1 of 3. Returns a presigned PUT URL (10 minutes) for the private patient bucket and an upload_id. Step 2: PUT the image bytes to upload_url with the returned headers and no Authorization header. Step 3: PATCH /users/me with profile_photo_id = upload_id. Nothing changes on the profile until step 3; uploads never saved are deleted after 24 hours. At most 10 unsaved uploads per patient per 24 hours. Use after registration with the tokens it returns; registration itself takes no photo.

otp.description: Numeric OTP string; length is backend OTP_LENGTH (currently 6).

refresh_token.description: Patient refresh token from the chosen account. An access token cannot be used here.

fcm_token.description: Accepted for compatibility; logout revokes the session, this field is ignored.
Stored as a string, truncated to 512 characters. Empty or omitted clears it.

dob.description: Null when only year of birth is known.

profile_photo.description: Presigned GET URL for the current profile photo, valid for 1 hour; null when there is no photo. A new URL is signed on every response: cache the image, not the URL, and read GET /users/me again when it expires.

id.description: Numeric PatientAccount ID, not a Care patient UUID.

title.description: Stored HMIS title, possibly empty for older patients.

gender_code.description: Stored Care gender enum for edit controls. Retains non_binary/transgender distinction while legacy gender display remains Other. Older records can contain other or empty; keep unchanged unless explicitly selecting a supported new value.

otp.description: Present only when SMS is disabled outside production; fixed development code.

is_new_user.description: False: accounts contains existing profiles. True: complete registration using registration_token; accounts is empty.

registration_token.description: Present for new numbers only. Single-use OTP proof, not an access token.

expires_in.description: Registration proof lifetime in seconds, present for new numbers only.

mobile.description: Send a 10-digit Indian mobile number. +91 and formatting are also normalized; shared desk numbers are refused.

registration_token.description: Single-use OTP proof bound to mobile, expires after 600 seconds. New OTP verification replaces the previous proof.

facility.description: Public nondeleted facility with a configured unit code; choose from GET auth/registration/facilities.

title.description: Must suit DOB and gender under HMIS allowed_titles rules.

dob.description: 1900-01-01 through hospital-local today; age at most 120.

password.description: Uppercase, lowercase, digit and one of !@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>. Store only a Django hash; no password sign-in in this contract.

MobileProfileUpdate.description: All fields optional. Omitted values preserved. Null not accepted. Empty strings clear optional contact/address/blood-group fields only. Mobile, password, facility, IDs and staff fields are rejected. Title must remain valid for the final DOB/gender; submit title together when needed.

dob.description: 1900-01-01 through hospital-local today; age at most 120.

title.description: Must suit DOB and gender under HMIS allowed_titles rules.

emergency_contact.description: Indian mobile number; 10 digits or +91 normalized. Empty string clears.

postal_code.description: Six-digit Indian PIN, or empty string to clear.

profile_photo_id.description: upload_id from POST /users/me/profile-photo after the image has been PUT to upload_url. The backend checks the object in S3 (JPEG/PNG/WebP as requested, non-empty, at most 5 MB), makes it the profile photo and archives the previous one. null removes the photo. Only the patient's own unarchived uploads are accepted.

mime_type.description: Content type of the image the app will upload. The PUT must send this exact Content-Type.

upload_id.description: Send as profile_photo_id in PATCH /users/me once the upload has finished.

upload_url.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL for the private patient bucket. No Authorization header.

headers.description: Headers the PUT must send exactly.
